import type { Metadata } from "next"; // An unlinked page: not in the sitemap, not in navigation, not indexed. export const metadata: Metadata = { title: "The Wine Bastard Manifesto", description: "What a Wine Bastard believes about wine, knowledge, memory and time.", robots: { index: false, follow: false }, }; export default function BastardPage() { return (

The Wine Bastard Manifesto

Every bottle carries a place, a maker, a history and a future.

What it means is yours.

Know more.
Make no one feel less.

A famous bottle can disappoint.
A humble one can stop the room.
You may say so.

Wine changes in the bottle.
What we know should not stand still.

The machine minds the cellar.
You mind the moments.

Know where it came from.
Know where you put it.
Know when to leave it there.

Some evenings need remembering.
Write them down before they improve with age.

Margins are for writing in.

Your cellar is nobody else’s business.

Enjoy it mightily.

); }
